description: Builds an llms.txt file in the llmstxt.org format from a site name, a summary, details and sections of links. Returns the file text and findings such as duplicate URLs or invalid links.

details.description: Optional extra text under the summary.

name.description: Site or project name, used as the file's title.

sections.description: Sections of links. Each link needs an absolute http or https URL.

summary.description: One or two sentences about the site.

name: llms_txt_generator
title: llms.txt generator
